layouts.name: Three-Card Spread

slots.label: Past
slots.meaning: What has shaped the current situation

layouts.name: Celtic Cross
layouts.description: The classic ten-card spread providing a comprehensive view of a situation.

slots.label: Recent Past
slots.meaning: Events just passed that still influence the present

slots.label: Past
slots.meaning: Foundational past events; what has led here

slots.label: Crown
slots.meaning: What the querent strives toward; best possible outcome

slots.label: Near Future
slots.meaning: What is approaching in the near term

slots.label: Self
slots.meaning: The querent's attitude, inner state, and self-perception

slots.label: External Environment
slots.meaning: How others see the querent; external influences

slots.label: Hopes and Fears
slots.meaning: The querent's deepest hopes or fears

slots.label: Outcome
